title: Trends and change
description: Describe trends, shifts, and gradual change over time.

introduction.headline: Talk about trends and change
introduction.body: You will learn vocabulary for describing patterns over time and explaining why change happens.
introduction.bodyIt: Imparerai vocabolario per descrivere andamenti nel tempo e spiegare perché avviene il cambiamento.
objectives: Use language of gradual and significant change
Link causes and consequences of change

vocabulary.example: Remote work is a growing trend.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Il lavoro remoto è una tendenza in crescita.

vocabulary.example: There has been a shift towards flexible hours.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: C'è stato uno spostamento verso orari flessibili.

vocabulary.example: The change has been gradual rather than sudden.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Il cambiamento è stato graduale piuttosto che improvviso.

vocabulary.example: Demand has risen significantly this year.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: La domanda è aumentata in modo significativo quest'anno.

exercises.prompt: What does a 'shift towards remote work' mean?
exercises.promptIt: Cosa significa uno 'shift towards remote work'?
options: A move in the direction of remote work
A sudden end to all office jobs
exercises.answer: A move in the direction of remote work
exercises.explanation: A shift towards X means a change in that direction.

exercises.prompt: Sales have risen ____ over the past decade.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: Sales have risen ____ over the past decade.
exercises.explanation: Significantly emphasises a large degree of change.

exercises.prompt: Which word best describes slow change over time?
exercises.promptIt: Quale parola descrive meglio un cambiamento lento nel tempo?
exercises.explanation: Gradual means happening slowly in stages.

review.tip: Describe one trend in your industry using rise, fall, or shift.
